label: ねこが白い
line: 下のねこが、白くなりました。
voice: したの、ねこが、しろく、なりました。
prompt: Edit this picture-book illustration: recolor ONLY the orange tabby cat sitting at the bottom right so that its fur becomes PURE WHITE (clean white fur, with its stripes drawn only as faint light grey lines; no orange or yellow left anywhere on the fur), same shape, size, pose, thick outlines and position. The snow, the wooden box and everything else stay exactly the same.

label: 雪だるまがない
line: 左の雪だるまが、なくなりました。
voice: ひだりの、ゆきだるまが、なくなりました。
prompt: Edit this picture-book illustration: erase the small snowman standing at the left, INCLUDING both of its brown twig arms (the left twig arm reaches out to the very left edge of the snowman, remove it completely), the carrot nose and the coal eyes and buttons, and repaint that whole area as the plain snowy ground and the wooden fence/wall behind it, matching the surroundings exactly. The result must contain NO snowman, no twig, no snow lump, no outline and no shadow where it stood. Do not change the wooden post, the broom or the stove.

label: つぼが緑
line: 右下のつぼが、緑になりました。
voice: みぎしたの、つぼが、みどりに、なりました。
prompt: Edit this picture-book illustration: recolor ONLY the brown clay jar (pot with a lid) at the bottom right so that it becomes clearly GREEN (a celadon / jade green glaze), keeping the same shape, size, thick outlines and shading. The floor and everything else stay exactly the same.

label: 街灯の電球が青
line: 右の街灯の、あかりが、青くなりました。
voice: みぎの、がいとうの、あかりが、あおく、なりました。
prompt: Edit this picture-book illustration: recolor ONLY the glowing round glass globe at the top of the street lamp (currently glowing warm yellow-white) so that it glows clearly BLUE (light blue glow), same shape and size. The lamp post, the buildings and the snow stay exactly the same.

label: シャベルの持ち手が黄色
line: シャベルの持ち手が、黄色くなりました。
voice: シャベルの、もちてが、きいろく、なりました。
prompt: Edit this picture-book illustration: recolor ONLY the red D-shaped grip (handle top) of the snow shovel so that it becomes clearly bright YELLOW, same shape, thick outlines and position. The wooden shaft, the red blade and everything else stay exactly the same.

label: 小鳥が増える
line: 雪の上に、小鳥が、1羽、増えました。
voice: ゆきのうえに、ことりが、いちわ、ふえました。
context: 雪の商店街の道に、スズメが1羽とまっているのは自然
prompt: Edit this picture-book illustration: add ONE tiny brown sparrow standing on the snowy ground, placed at the CENTER of this image (the whole bird fully inside the picture). The sparrow must be SMALL: its total width (beak to tail) is only about one sixth of the width of this image, so most of the image stays empty snow. Same thick dark outlines and watercolor picture-book style. Do not add anything else.

label: 葉っぱが赤
line: 雪うさぎの葉っぱが、赤くなりました。
voice: ゆきうさぎの、はっぱが、あかく、なりました。
prompt: Edit this picture-book illustration: recolor ONLY the two small green leaves (the ears) on top of the tiny snow bunny so that they become clearly bright RED, same shape, thick outlines and position. The snow bunny's white body, the rock and everything else stay exactly the same.

label: ランタンのガラスが黄色
line: ランタンのガラスが、黄色くなりました。
voice: ランタンの、ガラスが、きいろく、なりました。
prompt: Edit this picture-book illustration: recolor ONLY the glass panes inside the black iron lantern hanging on the wall so that they glow clearly warm YELLOW as if the lantern is lit, same shape and size. The black metal frame, the wall and everything else stay exactly the same.

label: みかんが増える
line: 雪の石の上に、みかんが、1つ、増えました。
voice: ゆきの、いしのうえに、みかんが、ひとつ、ふえました。
context: 雪の石段の上にみかんが1つ置いてあるのは自然（お供え・おやつ）
prompt: Edit this picture-book illustration: add ONE single round orange mandarin (with a small green leaf on top) sitting on the flat snow-covered top of the large stone step, placed at the CENTER of this image. The mandarin is SMALL: its diameter is only about one quarter (25 percent) of the width of this image. Same thick dark outlines and watercolor picture-book style. Do not add anything else.
